# The testify ledger: one `<package>:<kind> <sites> <reason>` row per package and kind
# still short of the standard's testing rule (docs/STANDARD.md, section 8; the class
# test is TestTestsUseTestify in internal/ci/testify_class_test.go).
#   assert    an `if` whose body calls t.Fatal, t.Fatalf, t.Error, t.Errorf, t.Fail or
#             t.FailNow: replace it with the testify call (require.NoError, assert.Equal,
#             assert.Contains, assert.ElementsMatch, assert.JSONEq, assert.Len ...)
#   env       a t.Setenv, t.Chdir or os.Chdir call: inject through the code's config
# Tests opening with t.Parallel() are held by TestEveryTestOpensWithTParallel and
# serial-tests_allowlist.txt, not by this ledger.
# The count only falls: a package measuring more sites than its row is a red run, a
# package with a site and no row is a red run, and a row above the tree is a red run.
# NOVA_CI_UPDATE=1 lowers the counts and drops the rows at zero; it never raises a
# count and never adds a row. Converting a test lowers its row in the same commit.
cmd/nova-bus:assert 801 bare assertions to convert to testify
